name: changer-teacher-to-analyst
note: Career changer with an education-first layout: a school teacher of nine years moving to data analysis after a bootcamp, with no professional data role yet and no metrics beyond class sizes. A stretch against a junior analyst posting that wants a year of commercial experience. The transferable material is real (stakeholder communication, spreadsheet work, the bootcamp SQL) and must not be dressed up as industry experience.
resume_text:
Fatima Shaikh
Ahmedabad, Gujarat | fatima.shaikh@example.com | +91 79331 40852

EDUCATION AND TRAINING

Data Analytics Programme, Aspire Data Academy, Ahmedabad
Completed September 2025. Six month part-time programme taken alongside full-time work.
Covered SQL, Excel and Power BI, Python for data analysis with pandas, statistics for
business, and data storytelling. Final capstone was an analysis of three years of municipal
water usage data published by the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, presented as a Power BI
dashboard with a written recommendation.

M.A. English Literature, Gujarat University, Ahmedabad, 2014 - 2016

B.A. English, St. Xavier's College, Ahmedabad, 2011 - 2014

B.Ed., Gujarat University, 2016 - 2017

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Rosewood International School, Ahmedabad
Secondary English Teacher and Assessment Coordinator | June 2017 - Present
- Teach English to classes of 38 to 45 students across grades 8 to 10.
- Took on the assessment coordinator role for the secondary section in 2021, which involves
  compiling and analysing termly results across eleven subject teachers and reporting
  patterns to the head of section.
- Rebuilt the school's assessment tracking from a set of unconnected teacher spreadsheets
  into one workbook with consistent structure, lookups and automatic summary sheets, which
  removed most of the manual re-entry at the end of each term.
- Identified from that data that a group of students were declining specifically in written
  response questions rather than across the board, which changed how the department planned
  remedial sessions.
- Present termly performance summaries to the school leadership team and to parents, where
  the audience has no background in statistics and the conclusions still need to land.
- Mentor two junior teachers on assessment design.

PROJECTS

Ahmedabad water usage analysis (capstone)
- Cleaned and joined three years of ward-level consumption data with population figures.
  Built a Power BI dashboard showing per capita usage by ward and seasonal variation, and
  wrote a short recommendation on where metering investment would pay back fastest.

Retail sales SQL exercise
- Wrote queries against a sample retail database covering joins, window functions, cohort
  retention and month-on-month growth. Published the queries and my reasoning on GitHub.

SKILLS
SQL: select, joins, group by, subqueries, window functions
Excel: pivot tables, VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH, conditional formatting, charts
Power BI: data model, relationships, basic DAX measures, dashboard design
Python: pandas, matplotlib at a beginner level
Other: data cleaning, report writing, presenting to non-technical audiences

LANGUAGES
English, Hindi, Gujarati, Urdu
jd_text:
Data Analyst
Bengaluru (Hybrid) | Business Intelligence | 7 - 12 LPA

We are a direct-to-consumer brand doing about 180 crore in annual revenue across our own
site, three marketplaces and eleven retail stores. The BI team is three people and reports
into the CFO. We are hiring a fourth.

The honest description of this job: a lot of it is making sure the numbers in one report
agree with the numbers in another, and then explaining to a category manager why their
best-selling product is losing money. It is not a modelling job.

What you will do
- Own reporting for two business lines: the weekly trading pack, monthly category reviews
  and whatever the commercial team asks for on a Tuesday afternoon
- Write SQL against our warehouse to answer questions, and then write the query again
  better once you understand what was actually being asked
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI, including the data model behind them rather
  than just the visuals
- Work with the data engineering team on the dbt models that feed your reports, and raise
  it when a model is wrong rather than working around it
- Do the analysis behind pricing and promotion decisions, including the post-mortem on
  whether a promotion worked
- Present findings to commercial and finance stakeholders who will push back

What we need
- 1 to 3 years in an analytics role in a commercial setting. This is the one requirement we
  are firm on: we need someone who has already had the experience of a stakeholder
  disagreeing with their numbers
- SQL you are genuinely comfortable in: joins, aggregations, window functions, CTEs. You
  will be writing it every day
- Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling
- Excel at a high level. A lot of this business still runs on it
- The ability to explain an analysis to someone who does not want to hear the answer
- Attention to detail. A wrong number in the trading pack gets seen by the board

Nice to have
- Python with pandas for the analysis that outgrows SQL
- dbt
- Retail, e-commerce or FMCG background
- Exposure to marketplace data: Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa seller reporting
- Basic statistics: significance, confidence intervals, and knowing when a difference is not
  one

Process: a SQL test, a case study where we give you a messy dataset and a business
question, and two conversations.
